clue.text: Tom with a note for a Titan goddess

parts.note: a tom is a male cat, so a he-cat
E is one of the notes of the musical scale

explanation.surface: A tomcat and a musical note somehow linked to a mythological goddess of the Titans.
explanation.walkthrough: Tom here is a male cat, written HE-CAT, rather than a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Hecate was a Greek goddess descended from the Titans, linked with witchcraft and crossroads.

clue.text: To make it bloom, take lid off and return to a lawman

indicators.note: to means the turned letters are attached after the lawman

parts.note: a DA is a District Attorney, an American law officer

indicators.note: return asks for the words lid off to be read backwards

explanation.surface: Instructions for making a plant flower: lift its lid and hand it back to a policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns LIDOFF into FFODIL, which is added 'to' DA.
explanation.definitionFit: A daffodil is a yellow spring flower, so a bloom.

clue.text: I can run her doggy about for sport

indicators.note: about signals the letters of the preceding words are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone boasts they can make their dog run around.
explanation.definitionFit: Racing dogs round a track after a lure is a spectator sport with betting.

clue.text: Disorder diagnosed by public health authority

annotationWithheld.why: Disorder diagnosed by public health authority (7): no parse of these words builds APHASIA (A + PHA leaves SIA unexplained); likely OCR loss or a missing word
annotationWithheld.clue: Disorder diagnosed by public health authority

clue.text: Short service commission for the chief mate?

definitions.text: Short service commission for the chief mate?

parts.words: Short service commission for the chief mate?
parts.note: a short service commission is a brief term as an officer; the chief mate on a merchant ship ranks just below the captain

explanation.definitionFit: The chief mate on a merchant ship is the deputy to the master, his next in rank.

clue.text: Tossed salad left in Ewing stronghold

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the mixed letters
a tossed salad has been mixed, so its letters are mixed too

explanation.surface: A green salad with something left in it, as served at a family ranch.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ewings were the oil family in the American TV soap 'Dallas', set at their Texas ranch Southfork.
explanation.definitionFit: The Texas city gave its name to the soap about the Ewing family, and was their home base.

clue.text: He's a bespectacled abstainer

parts.note: TT (teetotal, an abstainer) framed by two O shapes like a pair of spectacles gives a man's name

explanation.walkthrough: The two round letters at each end look like the lenses of glasses either side of TT, the abbreviation for teetotal.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name, so a fair 'he', drawn as a teetotaller wearing glasses.

clue.text: Jack's first meeting with Mrs Sharples in East Germany

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of the word Jack's

parts.note: Ena Sharples was a long-running gossip in the British TV soap Coronation Street

explanation.surface: A man called Jack meets a soap character on a trip to the old GDR.
explanation.walkthrough: Ena Sharples, in her hairnet, was a famous character in Coronation Street, a British TV soap opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Jena is a university city in Thuringia, formerly part of East Germany.

clue.text: Tear up letters of grave significance

definitions.meaning: to tear is to rend or pull apart
the initials carved on gravestones, short for Requiescat in pace

explanation.surface: Someone rips up a letter with serious news.
explanation.definitionFit: Rend is a synonym of tear; the three initials on headstones stand for 'rest in peace'.

clue.text: Card game to create furore

indicators.note: a furore is an uproar, so the letters of create are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A card game liable to cause an uproar at the table.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecarte is a two-player card game of French origin.

clue.text: Might take to the air, albeit short-lived

definitions.note: the definition describes the insect by its brief adult life

parts.note: might and may both express possibility
to fly is to take to the air

explanation.surface: Something might take off into the sky though it will not last long.
explanation.definitionFit: This insect's adult stage lasts as little as a day, the byword for a brief existence.

clue.text: Devil of a parrot over there

parts.note: Poll, like Polly, is a traditional name for a pet parrot
yon is an old word meaning that over there

explanation.surface: A devilish parrot perched some way off.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as A POLL YON, not A POLLY ON: the parrot is POLL.
explanation.definitionFit: Apollyon is the destroying angel of the Book of Revelation, a name for the Devil in The Pilgrim's Progress.

clue.text: The tops when it comes to work?

definitions.text: The tops when it comes to work?

parts.words: The tops when it comes to work?
parts.note: the bosses at the top of commerce and manufacturing, read as the uppermost parts of business

explanation.definitionFit: Captains of business are the leaders of manufacturing and commerce.

clue.text: Bird never seen in September/October

indicators.note: in tells the solver the letters sit inside the words September/October, across the slash

explanation.surface: A migrant bird that never shows up in the autumn months.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird sits across the slash in 'Septembe(r/Oc)tober'.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is a giant mythical bird from the Arabian Nights, so no one has seen it.

clue.text: Town crier's vocation

definitions.meaning: what a town crier does is shout out the news
a vocation is a career or strong sense of purpose

explanation.surface: Being a town crier is a job someone is born to.
explanation.definitionFit: Crying out aloud describes a town crier's job; a calling is also a person's vocation.

clue.text: Has put out the remains of a burnt offering?

definitions.text: the remains of a burnt offering?

indicators.note: put out suggests the word Has is disturbed and its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone has extinguished the fire on an altar sacrifice.
explanation.definitionFit: What is left after burning is cinders and powder.

clue.text: Biblical town averse to a Scottish expression

parts.note: anti means against or averse to
och is a Scottish exclamation

explanation.surface: A town in Scripture dislikes a Scot's exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: Antioch appears in Acts as the city where followers of Jesus were first called Christians.

clue.text: Static indeed, I've concluded

indicators.note: concluded means the other piece comes at the end

parts.note: read as 'in deed', in the very act
taken as written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone declares they have finished and are now motionless.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'indeed' into 'in deed', which means IN ACT.
explanation.definitionFit: Static means not moving, the same as idle or dormant.

clue.text: Sounds an exhortation to spend recklessly before long

indicators.note: sounds says the answer is said like the following phrase

parts.note: urging someone to buy and buy again

explanation.surface: Advertising urges people to shop freely, promising rewards soon.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means eventually, in a little while.

clue.text: Old King Cole?

parts.note: the nursery-rhyme king was 'a merry old soul', so he is described by his good humour and his crown

explanation.walkthrough: Old King Cole is the cheerful king of an English nursery rhyme; the phrase is also the nickname of Charles II.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles II's nickname suits the rhyme's jolly ruler who called for his pipe and fiddlers three.

clue.text: Transportable, apparently, in Alabama

definitions.meaning: a port city on the Gulf coast of Alabama

explanation.surface: Something portable, as they say in the American South.
explanation.definitionFit: Movable things are portable; Mobile is the Alabama port city.

clue.text: Work on a nervous complaint

indicators.note: on in a down clue puts A after the work

parts.note: a chore is a piece of work or task

explanation.surface: Doing tasks brings on a nervous illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Chorea is a disorder of the nerves causing jerky involuntary movements, as in St Vitus's dance.

clue.text: Watch-tower designed for entertainment in the City

definitions.meaning: an outer fortification tower over a gate

definitions.text: designed for entertainment in the City
definitions.meaning: the arts centre in the City of London

explanation.surface: A tower built for amusements in the financial district.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, home of the Barbican Centre for concerts and theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A barbican is a fortified gatehouse tower; the Barbican Centre is a London arts complex.

clue.text: Old-more than half Methuselah's years

definitions.meaning: anyone past half the 969 years Genesis gives Methuselah would be very elderly

explanation.surface: Someone is old, older than half of Methuselah's great lifespan.
explanation.definitionFit: Elderly is a synonym of old, and a person of over 480 years is certainly elderly.

clue.text: Proposal suggesting one is 21

definitions.meaning: a formal proposal put to a meeting
21 refers to the answer at 21 down, meaning moving

explanation.surface: A suggestion put forward that one has come of age.
explanation.walkthrough: '21' is not an age but the answer to 21 down: something mobile is in motion.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal at a debate is a formal motion; something mobile is moving, in movement.

clue.text: Legendary wizard bird

explanation.surface: A mythical magician who is also a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Merlin advised King Arthur; a merlin is a small European falcon.

clue.text: A follower gets an order of restraint

parts.note: B follows A in the alphabet

explanation.surface: A disciple receives an injunction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A follower' is the letter after A, not a disciple.
explanation.definitionFit: A prohibition forbids an action, restraining it.

clue.text: Number we turn to look at

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: turn means the word we is read backwards

explanation.surface: A number of us turn to inspect something.
explanation.definitionFit: To view something is to watch or inspect it.
